"He who fights with monsters might take care lest he thereby become a monster. And if you gaze for long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you."

Friedrich Nietzsche. Beyond Good and Evil (1866).

You might like to think that if the rape gang (sexual conquest gang) scandal had come to your attention you certainly would not have denied what was happening, or remained silent.

Stop. Dare to really ask yourself (instead of just assuming your virtue):

You would've put your career on the line?
